source.citation: Made-up conversation written for tests. Not real call data.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Why does my promo code say invalid?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Promo codes usually last 7 days, so a code issued longer ago than that has expired.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: If you are a gold, silver or bronze member I can issue you a new code.

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Membership level of gold has been noted.

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: A promo code has been created.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I've sent you a new code, it is for 20% off your next purchase.

note: Answer consistent with the ABCD promo-code guideline, with its conditions.
